title: Rorca Context Usage Visibility — Spec Generation & Run View
description: Make context injection fully visible in two places: (1) the Spec slide-over Context tab, where the existing ContextSummaryCard exists but is buried below the fold and shows only boolean presence flags — elevate it and enrich it with skill chips with relevance scores, direction layer titles with token sizes, and injected file list; (2) the Run View Stories tab, where per-story context injection is fully tracked in the backend (contextComparison.actual has injected files, story_results.active_skills has skills, WAL events have full detail) but no UI surfaces it. Background: spec_generation_logs.context_summary already stores directionLayers, skills[], memoryEntries, estimatedTokens, and retrievalMeta. The execution engine already emits context_files and active_skills in the story_started WAL event. contextComparison.actual is already in the GET /api/pipeline/runs/:runId response. This spec is 90% a frontend visibility change — the backend data is already there.

userStories.title: Elevate ContextSummaryCard in Context tab — always visible, above the fold
userStories.description: In src/components/SpecDetailSlideOver.tsx, the GenerationLogTab component renders the ContextSummaryCard conditionally as the last element inside each log entry card (gated by `contextSummary && contextSummary.directionLayers`). This puts it below the status header, token row, and error section — requiring the user to scroll to see it. Restructure the layout so the ContextSummaryCard is the PRIMARY content of the Context tab, displayed ABOVE the generation metadata header. New layout order from top to bottom: (1) ContextSummaryCard (the full direction/skills/memory breakdown), (2) Generation header (status icon, model badge, duration, tokens, cost), (3) Error detail if failed. Remove the `contextSummary.directionLayers` gate — show the card whenever context_summary exists and has any non-empty data (check `contextSummary && Object.keys(contextSummary).length > 0`). When context_summary is empty `{}` (pre-migration specs), show only the generation header. The 'Show all generation attempts' toggle remains at the bottom. This is purely a layout reorder inside GenerationLogTab — no backend changes needed.
acceptanceCriteria: Opening the Context tab immediately shows the ContextSummaryCard without scrolling

Error detail section still renders below the generation header when log.error is present
'Show all generation attempts' toggle remains at the bottom
Multiple generation attempts still render as separate stacked cards, each with card-first layout

userStories.title: Direction layer titles and token contribution in ContextSummaryCard
userStories.description: The ContextSummaryCard currently shows direction layers as simple boolean badges (L1 ✓, L2 —, L3 ✓). Users can't see what L1/L2/L3 actually contain or how much token budget they consumed. Two parts: BACKEND — extend precomputedContextSummary in backend/src/routes/specs.ts (lines 793-825) to store direction layer titles and estimated token sizes. The synthesize() function in direction-stack.ts returns the merged direction string and meta object (synthResult.meta.standards, conventions, project). Extract the first line of each layer content as the 'title' (or fall back to 'Standards', 'Conventions', 'Project'). Add token estimates per layer using Math.ceil(layerContent.length / 4). New context_summary fields: `directionLayers.l1Title: string | null`, `directionLayers.l2Title: string | null`, `directionLayers.l3Title: string | null`, `directionLayers.l1Tokens: number`, `directionLayers.l2Tokens: number`, `directionLayers.l3Tokens: number`. FRONTEND — update ContextSummaryCard.tsx and the ContextSummary TypeScript interface in src/panels/SpecForgeOutput.tsx to accept and display the new fields. Render each present layer as: 'L1 Engineering Principles · 820 tokens' (title + token badge). Absent layers still render as '—'. The token badge uses the same style as the estimated tokens bar.

Old generation logs without the new fields still render gracefully (show boolean badge only)

Token estimate uses Math.ceil(layerContent.length / 4) chars-to-tokens formula

userStories.title: Skill chips with relevance and reason in ContextSummaryCard
userStories.description: The ContextSummaryCard renders matched skills as a plain comma-separated text: `{skills.join(', ')}`. This loses the relevance score and reason that exist in spec.suggestedSkills (aggregated across stories). Replace the plain text with styled chips. In ContextSummaryCard.tsx: accept an optional `skillDetails: Array<{ name: string; relevance?: number; reason?: string }>` prop alongside the existing `skills: string[]`. Populate this prop in GenerationLogTab by reading the parent component's `stories` prop (already available in SpecDetailSlideOver scope) and aggregating the highest relevance per unique skill name across all stories' suggestedSkills arrays (using the same toSkill() normalizer from OT-002). Pass as `skillDetails` into ContextSummaryCard. Chip rendering: name in font-mono, relevance score in a small badge colored by tier (emerald ≥8, blue ≥5, gray <5). Hovering a chip shows the reason in a tooltip (title attribute). If skillDetails is not provided (old code paths, SpecForgeProgress usage), fall back to the existing `skills.join(', ')` plain text. Chips are arranged in a flex-wrap row replacing the existing plain text span.

When skillDetails is absent (old code paths), falls back to plain comma-separated text

GenerationLogTab passes skillDetails computed from the stories prop to ContextSummaryCard

userStories.title: Injected context files list in ContextSummaryCard
userStories.description: The context_summary does not store injected file paths (those come from the story_started WAL event at run time, not spec generation time). However, there IS a spec-generation-time equivalent: the context-router computes predicted injected files per story and stores them in pipeline_runs.context_preview (set in POST /api/pipeline/trigger). For the Context tab display, add a collapsible 'Context Files' section to ContextSummaryCard showing the union of all predicted injected files across stories. BACKEND: In specs.ts, when building precomputedContextSummary (lines 793-825), call routeContext() for each story using the workspace's .rorca/config.json routing and aggregate the unique file paths. Store as `predictedFiles: string[]` in context_summary. Limit to 30 paths (sort by priority descending, drop overflow). FRONTEND: Add a new collapsible section in ContextSummaryCard below the skills section: 'Context Files (N)' that expands to show the file paths as code spans, grouped by category (global vs scoped — globals have no glob pattern scope, scoped have one). Show at most 20 files, with a '+N more' link if truncated. Collapsed by default. This gives users visibility into exactly what files the agent would read.

userStories.title: Per-story context injection accordion in Run View Stories tab
userStories.description: The StoriesListTab component in src/panels/RunViewPanel.tsx shows story ID, title, status dot, elapsed time, and commit SHA. It has no context visibility. Add a context accordion per story: clicking a small 'Context' chevron button on the right of each story row expands a drawer below it. The drawer shows three sections: (1) SKILLS — list of active_skills for this story (from story_results.active_skills JSON column, parsed from the run's stories array). For each skill: name + relevance badge (cross-referenced from specStories[i].suggestedSkills). (2) CONTEXT FILES — list of injected files for this story from contextComparison.actual[storyId].contextFiles (already in the run response). Show as code spans in a flex-wrap layout. (3) TOKENS — input/output token counts for this story (from story_results.input_tokens/output_tokens, already in the run's storyTokenBreakdown). All three data sources are already in the GET /api/pipeline/runs/:runId response (stories array, contextComparison, storyTokenBreakdown). No new backend API calls needed. The accordion uses local component state (expandedStoryId: string | null). Only one story is expanded at a time. The chevron rotates 90° when expanded.

userStories.title: Context usage summary bar in Run View header
userStories.description: The Run View (src/panels/RunViewPanel.tsx) currently shows run status, spec name, and story progress at the top. Add a compact context usage summary bar just below the header (above the tab bar). It shows: unique skill count with a Sparkles icon, unique context file count with a Files icon, average input tokens per story with a Cpu icon, and a 'Context' label that links to the Skills tab (clicking scrolls to or activates the 'Skills' tab). The summary bar is a single flex row with compact stats, similar to the 'N stories | N passed' bar. Data sources: (1) unique skills — count distinct skill names across all story_results.active_skills in the run response; (2) unique context files — count distinct paths across contextComparison.actual values; (3) avg input tokens — average of storyTokenBreakdown[i].inputTokens where inputTokens > 0 (only count stories that ran). Show as: '3 skills · 12 files · ~2.1K tokens/story'. If all three values are 0 or unavailable (e.g., run hasn't started yet), hide the bar. The bar appears for all run states (running, completed, failed) — reflects whatever data is available.
